source_text: dreám-hæbbende; part. [dreám I. joy, hæbbende having, possessing] Possessing bliss, joyful; læt&a-long;bundus :-- Þrymmas weóxon dreámhæbbendra the glories of the possessors of bliss increased, Cd. 4; Th. 5, 34; Gen. 81.
